exceptions.rationale: Compatibility transition for this exact job-level reusable RustSec workflow call. GitHub resolves this local workflow at the caller commit before jobs run; it is not a workspace-relative action step that earlier untrusted steps can replace. The callee has only contents:read, no inherited secrets and no cache writes. Keep #281's currently supported local-reference syntax until its policy explicitly validates the new self-repository syntax. Parent review is required; update the pin policy or re-review this exact call before expiry.
